decisions.executionNote: Approach the tiara in the left workspace, gradually pitching the left gripper downward; right arm stays still.
Retry with smaller increments to respect joint continuity while beginning the left-arm approach.
Continue a smooth elbow-up approach, opening retained and gradually orienting for a top grasp.
Advance above the tiara with continued downward pitch, keeping the left arm configuration continuous.
Move toward the tiara from above, maintaining a smooth top-down orientation transition and clearance.
Correct rightward toward the tiara within the left workspace and finish approaching a downward grasp orientation.
Align over a side section of the tiara rim rather than spanning the entire crown; use small near-object corrections.
Close around the visible near-side tiara rim, keeping the wrist stationary; retention must be checked during a lift.
Lift gently with the left gripper fully closed and check whether the tiara follows rather than slipping.
The tiara did not follow the test lift. Reopen and approach slightly farther forward and lower for a deeper rim grasp.
Seat the open fingertips lower around the near decorative rim with small alignment corrections before closing.
Stop descending after contact resistance, relieve slightly upward, and close around the tiara panel for another retention check.
Test the deeper grasp with a slow vertical lift, keeping full closure and watching the tiara relative to the fingertips.
The tiara slipped again. Reopen, clear it vertically, and begin turning the jaws to pinch across the rim thickness rather than along it.
Target the now-exposed curved side of the tiara, positioning the jaws on opposite sides of its thin rim.
Lower the open jaws around the aligned curved rim without sweeping sideways or pressing down on it.
Close across the exposed side section after a shallow final descent, aiming to trap the structural rim rather than its decorative tip.
Allow full closure on the side rim before beginning a very small lift to verify retention.
The side rim is visibly between the jaws. Continue a controlled vertical lift while retaining full closure.
The tiara appears retained at the side rim. Lift another five centimeters vertically, keeping the jaws closed and configuration continuous.
Replan after the joint-continuity rejection: retreat slightly toward the robot while lifting in smaller increments to preserve reach margin and the grasp.
Continue lifting the retained tiara with a gentle inward retreat to keep the elbow bent and obtain clear height above the table.
